authority: Adobe Experience League (drafted from local aem_guides corpus; URLs confirmed only where the corpus returned a clean page)
note: Large surface; may be split into EDITOR_CANVAS and MAP_AUTHORING sub-surfaces if it grows past ~15 features.

shared_flows: reference resolution at author and output
native_features.candidate_template: conref/conkeyref/keyref insertion resolves the reused content, and broken or missing references are handled at author time and in output

native_features.feature: cross-references and links (xref, related links, external links)
native_features.candidate_template: xref, related-links, and external links preserve href, format, scope, and type and resolve to the correct target

native_features.feature: map authoring (topicref, topichead, keydef, map tree, navtitle/locktitle)
native_features.candidate_template: adding/moving topicref, topichead, and keydef in the map tree preserves hierarchy, navtitle/locktitle, and key definitions

native_features.feature: tables (CALS and simpletable, row/column ops, pasted tables)
native_features.candidate_template: insert/delete rows and columns and pasted tables keep valid CALS/simpletable structure with no ghost or orphan cells

native_features.feature: media and image insertion (asset references from DAM)
native_features.candidate_template: inserted images/multimedia reference the correct DAM asset and render in author, preview, and output

native_features.feature: conditional attribute profiling (apply DITAVAL at author)
native_features.candidate_template: applied conditional attributes profile the content correctly at author time and carry through to conditional output
topic and map metadata/properties set in the editor are stored on the correct node and propagate to output and reports
new topics/maps created from configured templates produce the expected structure and default content

native_features.feature: version lifecycle (check-in/check-out, save, autosave, version history)
native_features.candidate_template: check-out/check-in, save, autosave, and version history behave correctly and do not lose or misattribute edits
switching between Author, Source, and Preview preserves content, caret/selection, and unsaved edits
configured special characters/symbols are insertable and preserved through save and output
native_features.reference: Configure additional special characters in Editor toolbar

native_features.candidate_template: MathML/equation insertion produces valid markup that renders in author, preview, and each output preset
track-changes and change-bar authoring records author edits correctly and integrates with review and output
DTD/schema and Schematron validation flags invalid content at author time with the correct messages and does not block valid content
